_about: Partner offers. An offer shows on every active route that passes within its radius (metres), or on every route if allRoutes is true. A Ride with GPS stop whose name matches matchPoi is replaced by the offer. Set validUntil (YYYY-MM-DD) to have it hide itself after that date. hideOn lists route slugs to leave it off. lat and lng are worked out from where (an address or a Google Maps link). Managed on the Ride Guide Settings page. logo is a file in site/ (shown on the card in place of the partner name). conditions can be one line or a list of lines. about is a short description under the headline; phone adds a Call button. showAt is "anywhere" (the default: shown on the route page and when riders pass it) or "finish" (only brought up near the end of the ride and on the finish card, for a partner near the shop).
